# Popover

A small click-opened panel anchored to its trigger for interactive content: spare-track suggestions, a column chooser, key detail with compatible keys.

`SongNodes.Popover` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Popover trigger={…} title={…}>…</SongNodes.Popover>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Popover" trigger="{{…}}" title="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Props (PopoverProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` * | `ReactNode` | Trigger button (gets aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-haspopup="dialog"). |
| `title` * | `ReactNode` | Title at the top; focus moves here on open. |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` | Interactive content: lists, checkboxes, small actions. |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` | Footer actions or a link. |
| `open` | `boolean` | Controlled open state. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | Open change (click trigger, Esc, outside click, focus leaving). |
| `align` | `"start" \| "end"` | Align to the trigger's start or end edge. |
| `side` | `"bottom" \| "top"` | Open below (default) or above. |
